get_model_haiku_params: get the Haiku model parameters from a directory containing AlphaFold 3 model weight files
encode_record: encode a single Haiku parameter as bytes with scope, name, and numpy array data
read_records: read all encoded parameter records from a byte stream and yield scope, name, and array tuples
select_model_files: select and return model weight files from a directory matching .bin or .bin.zst patterns
open_for_reading: open multiple model files as a single concatenated stream with optional zstandard decompression
